g.text: Validated V4.1/no-curv path + stronger per-point residual head
tested in V4.4; useful idea but final
If V4.5 > no_curv, train V4.6 = V4.5 + continuous
interpolation. If not, keep no_curv as the paper-safe main
stronger point-specific head may improve local
zero-init residual, shared head retained, old
Green = experimentally validated in current ablations; orange = V4.5 mechanism under validation; red = tested but not selected as main line.
